Subject: Vendor onboarding — basic PO requirements + Coupa registration

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this on. Midline is standing up Coupa onboarding for our new suppliers and we want to confirm a few items before we create the supplier invitation:

- PO acknowledgement window: our Ops team prefers a 48-hour acknowledgement window on all POs. Can your team accept that in contract or via portal ACK?
- PO line-item unit-of-measure and tax fields: we need the vendor to accept 'unit' and provide VAT/tax id mapping on the registration form.
- Invoice remit/EDI: for larger POs we'll require EDI 810 or SFTP invoice drops; please confirm.

We have one vendor contact here (Dan) who will be completing the Coupa registration once we confirm requirements. Also attaching a short template of the fields we expect on the Coupa vendor form.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can issue the invite this week.

Best,
Susan

Midline Health

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — basic PO requirements + Coupa registration

Hi Susan,

Thanks — looping in Vivek (ops) and Marissa (legal lead) to confirm. Quick answers up front:

- ACK window: we can meet a 48-hour PO acknowledgement in the portal for standard orders, but need to capture an exception for custom hardware / dedicated capacity orders where lead times exceed 10 business days.
- Tax/VAT: registration can capture VAT/Tax ID and unit-of-measure on line items. We'll need to validate the field format — I attached our standard PO field map for your team to review.
- Invoicing: we support both EDI 810 and SFTP drops; EDI setup usually follows registration and takes ~3 weeks.

Marissa — can you review the proposed change to the acceptance clause? Midline is asking for a contractual ACK requirement of 48 hours (they called it an "acknowledgement window"). I'm attaching our redline doc with the clause highlighted (Proposed_MSA_redlines_v2.docx) and a short suggested clause in plain text.

Action items:
- Marissa: advise on wording we can accept in MSA or an Order Form addendum that preserves our ability to reject partials and keeps lead-time exceptions.
- Vivek: confirm whether portal ACK will generate automatic order status back to Coupa and whether we can automate rejections for mismatched quantities.
- Susan/Dan: please confirm if Midline's Coupa template accepts an "ACK reason" field for exceptions.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — basic PO requirements + Coupa registration

Team — I reviewed the proposed redline and the ask from Midline. Summary and recommended compromise below.

1) ACK window (48 hours): acceptable in an Order Form addendum if we include the following carve-outs:
   - Exceptions for "non-standard goods" and "lead-time items" where vendor must acknowledge within a reasonable time tied to the lead-time (e.g., "acknowledge within 5 business days if lead time > 10 business days").
   - Automatic extension for weekends/holidays and system outages.

2) Partial shipments & rejection: we should keep express language that Redwood may reject partial shipments that materially deviate from PO quantities or are nonconforming. We can add a portal-specific flow: if Coupa ACK indicates a quantity mismatch, the ACK should include an "ACK reason" code and an expected fulfillment ETA; otherwise the ACK is treated as acceptance of the line-item.

3) Remedies / SLA: avoid any acceptance that creates a de facto acceptance of late delivery. No contract language that shortens our right to dispute invoices if goods are nonconforming.

Proposed next steps (actionable):
- Monica: send Midline the slim addendum text below (I also added it to Acceptance_Clause_Suggested.txt).
- Vivek/Karthik: confirm technical feasibility of adding an "ACK reason" code and returning "expected fulfillment ETA" in the Coupa ACK webhook. If feasible, provide field names and sample payload so Midline can map in their Coupa template.
- Legal & Procurement: once Midline confirms, we'll include the 48-hour ACK clause in the Order Form and require the vendor to complete the Coupa registration with those fields.

Slim addendum (to be included on Order Form):
"Vendor shall acknowledge receipt of each Purchase Order via the Coupa vendor portal within 48 hours of issuance, except for orders for goods or services with a vendor-specified lead time exceeding ten (10) business days, in which case Vendor shall acknowledge within five (5) business days. An acknowledgement that reports a quantity or delivery discrepancy must include a standard 'ACK reason' code and an expected fulfillment ETA. An acknowledgement does not constitute acceptance of nonconforming goods. Redwood reserves all rights to reject nonconforming goods and dispute related invoices."

I'll stand by for the tech sample.

-Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — basic PO requirements + Coupa registration

Hi all — quick ops confirmation following Marissa's note. We can support the flows Marissa described. High-level tech details below for mapping into Midline's Coupa template: 

- ACK webhook payload: {
    "po_number": "string",
    "line_items": [ { "line_id": "string", "ack_status": "ACCEPTED|REJECTED|PARTIAL", "ack_reason_code": "string", "expected_fulfillment_eta": "YYYY-MM-DD" } ]
  }

- Field names to include on vendor registration / Coupa form: vendor_tax_id, remit_email, edi_enabled (boolean), sftp_endpoint (optional), preferred_uom.
- EDI 810: we support full EDI 810 for invoicing; estimated EDI enablement for a vendor is 2–3 weeks after registration is complete.
- Automatic rejections: we can configure a rule that if ack_status == REJECTED and no ack_reason_code provided, the system flags the order for manual review (not auto-cancel).

Next steps: Monica, if Midline confirms the addendum language, we will: (1) update our portal docs with field names and example webhook payload (I'll post the Drive link), (2) schedule a short onboarding call with Dan to walk the vendor through registration and EDI enablement.

Drive link (draft docs): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPOFieldMap

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
